summary.zh: 用一个 API 定时发布到多个社交平台
summary.en: Schedule and publish posts across social platforms via one API.

description.zh: 统一管理多个社交平台的发帖、排期、媒体附件和互动数据，适合一次性投放多平台内容。需要 SocialClaw API Key，并提前在服务端连好各平台账号。
description.en: Publishes and schedules posts, attaches media and pulls engagement stats across social platforms from one workspace. Suited to multi-platform campaigns. Requires a SocialClaw API key and connected accounts.
